enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move legs. Remain sleeping. Snore. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Take out eggs, bread, butter, milk from refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add butter. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread in toaster. Place eggs and toast on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Add coffee. Stir. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag and lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt and pants. Put on socks and shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Place lunch box and water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take notes. Walk to nurses' station. Enter data into computer. Call doctor. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Adjust IV. Check monitor. Talk to patient. Walk to break room. Drink water. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay at cashier. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Check phone. Stand up. Push chair in. Walk to trash can. Throw away trash. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, continuing patient care and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Enter patient room. Check IV. Adjust drip. Talk to patient. Walk to computer. Type notes. Print chart. Walk to patient room. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Walk to nurses' station. Update chart. Call lab. Walk to lab. Pick up results. Walk back to ward. Talk to doctor. Walk to break room. Drink water.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat, sauce. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch show. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Put down drink. Pick up remote. Change channels. Watch show. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal admin and light leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Check email. Pay bills. Play game. Close game. Type notes. Save document. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk to sofa. Sit on sofa. Read book. Put down book. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, watching TV and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check messages. Open app. Scroll. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Turn to side. Breathe slowly. Fall asleep.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move legs. Remain sleeping. Snore. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.
